subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Acetylmanganese tetracarbonyl（MeC(O)Mn(CO)₄）？
A. Square pyramidal
B. Trigonal bipyramidal
C. Octahedral
D. Tetrahedral
explanation: Square pyramidal. Covalent count: Mn (group 7) 7 e; 1 × C(O)Me (X) 1 e; 4 × CO (L) 8 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −1 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Mn(I), d⁶; d⁶ + 10 e from the ligands = 16 e. The 16-electron intermediate right after migratory insertion; it picks up a ligand to return to 18.
